name: opencode-switchboard
description: A better session tabs panel for OpenCode: sessions grouped by project and worktree, unread marks, and Later to snooze work.

scripts.smoke: bun run build && node scripts/smoke.mjs && node scripts/smoke.mjs session && node scripts/smoke.mjs session delete && node scripts/smoke.mjs session navigation
scripts.smoke:client: bun run build:client && node scripts/smoke.mjs bundled && node scripts/smoke.mjs bundled session auto && node scripts/smoke.mjs bundled session activate && node scripts/smoke.mjs bundled session delete && node scripts/smoke.mjs bundled session navigation auto
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun test test/model.test.ts test/selection.test.tsx test/panel.test.tsx test/attention.test.ts test/palette.test.ts test/session-creation.test.tsx test/deletion.test.tsx test/navigation.test.tsx && npm run test:releases
scripts.postpublish: gh workflow run sync-releases.yml --ref main -f version=$npm_package_version

author: Abe Isleem
